subject: Tata Sierra vs Hyundai Creta
_angle: OPT1 · Head vs Heart — safe-bet Creta vs reborn Sierra; balanced round-by-round, calm delivery (proven winner tone)

segments.text: Both start near eleven lakh — so, the safe-bet Creta, or the reborn Sierra?
The Sierra packs a hundred-sixty turbo horses; the Creta petrol makes a hundred-fifteen.
But the Creta hits back with ventilated seats, wireless charging, and that comfort-first reputation.
The Sierra's reply? Panoramic roof, and a thirteen-speaker JBL Dolby system. Smash like for the Sierra.
So — head, or heart? Sierra or Creta? Comment one or two. Like, share, and subscribe.
